Location: Fremont, CA (Hybrid / Remote across the U.S.)
Compensation: $20.00 / hour
Employment Type: InternshipAbout CLOUDAIHUB LLC
CLOUDAIHUB LLC helps businesses design, migrate, secure, and scale cloud, database, and AI architectures. Headquartered in Fremont, CA and serving teams nationwide, we deliver zero-downtime cloud migrations, managed cloud operations, security and compliance readiness (SOC2, HIPAA, PCI, GDPR), and cost optimization across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI, and IBM Cloud.Role Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Cloud Engineering Intern to assist our engineers with cloud infrastructure setup, migrations, database support, and operational documentation. This is a practical learning role where you will work directly with live cloud environments and client deliverables.What You Will Do

- Assist with cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and maintenance across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Support cloud migration tasks, environment testing, and basic monitoring/alerting checks.
- Help with database administration support, backups, query/performance checks, and security hardening checklists.
- Document architectures, runbooks, and compliance/security controls (e.g., SOC2, HIPAA, GDPR readiness items).
- Collaborate with senior engineers and support our 4-week hands-on training initiatives when needed.Qualifications

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree/certificate in Computer Science, Cloud Computing, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on project experience).
- Basic familiarity with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Linux/command-line fundamentals.
- Comfort with basic networking concepts and scripting (Bash or Python).
- Strong communication skills, curiosity, and attention to detail.What You Get

- $20/hour competitive internship pay.
- Real-world exposure to multi-cloud architecture, databases, and client consulting workflows.
- Mentorship from experienced cloud and database practitioners at CLOUDAIHUB LLC.How to Apply

- Send your resume  to info@cloudaihub.ai
